name: Render resolution 1280x720, output 1280x720
description: Output and render resolution 1280x720. The game's defaults are an output of 3840x2160 and a render resolution of 2560x1440; this patch sets both, so the scene, the upscale, the UI and the final composition all run at the lower size. Use only one of the three variants. The picture is softer than at 1080p; the HUD layout is unchanged.
author: batatinhafcbatatinha-pixel
tested: KytyPS5 fork ff3de3fd with a measuring probe (local build, 2026-11-14), first gameplay scene, RTX 3050 laptop GPU, Ryzen 5 3600: right picture, no device loss, 59.6 fps (six 10 s windows, 59.0-59.9) against 51.3 fps with render 1280x720 and the output left at 3840x2160, in the run before it with the same build; the display's 60 Hz limit applies. One scene, one run. Not run in AnyPS5.
